$comment: Single source of truth for username validation, consumed by crates/server/src/auth/username.rs (include_str!) and apps/web/src/api/account.ts (JSON import). Algorithm on both sides: normalise (trim, Unicode full lowercase mapping — JS String.prototype.toLowerCase and Rust str::to_lowercase both implement Unicode Default Case Conversion including SpecialCasing, and the only non-ASCII code point that lowercases INTO the accepted ASCII set is U+212A KELVIN SIGN → k; everything else non-ASCII fails `charset` on both sides); measure length in UTF-16 code units (JS String.length / Rust encode_utf16().count()); reject on length outside [min_length, max_length]; reject when `pattern` fails, reporting `messages.charset` if `charset_pattern` also fails and `messages.hyphens` otherwise; reject when the handle is in `reserved`. `{min}`/`{max}` in messages are substituted from the length bounds. Behaviour is pinned by username_cases.json, which both test suites run. Keep `reserved` lowercase and sorted.

messages.charset: Username may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
messages.hyphens: Username cannot start, end, or contain consecutive hyphens
